wikipedia.description:
Wikipedia is the official Android application from the Wikimedia Foundation, bringing the free encyclopedia to your phone with a comfortable, customizable reading experience.

Search millions of articles across hundreds of languages, discover new topics through the Explore feed, and browse featured articles, popular pages, historical events, pictures of the day, and recommended reading. Save articles into collections for later reading, including offline access to downloaded content. Adjust text size and appearance with light, dark, and black themes.

The app also supports Wikipedia participation through article editing, suggested contributions, and access to community features. Multilingual readers can switch between language editions while exploring knowledge.

Wikipedia is free, open source, and advertising-free. Developed by the nonprofit Wikimedia Foundation, it provides convenient access to collaboratively created knowledge without a paid subscription. Some features, including synchronization and editing, require an internet connection or a Wikipedia account. The app is intended for Wikipedia projects rather than arbitrary custom MediaWiki servers.
